issue.title: Give sase memory history text output and the Memory panel History row the pager's version pill vocabulary and ≡ now marker

task_type_fields.proposal: PROPOSED BY phase bead sase-1ef.5 (epic sase-1ef, plan plan:202610/pager_version_clarity.md §10). Render `sase memory history` text output and the ACE Memory panel History row with the same version vocabulary the pager uses: absolute vK of N numbering (hidden versions counted), the ● NOW / ◌ NOW · uncommitted / ⟲ PAST · vK of N / ✖ DELETED states, and the 'now ≡ vN' marker when the worktree, HEAD, and newest blob OIDs match (D3). Reuse the pure helpers in src/sase/pager/history/moment.py (build_moment, VersionMoment) rather than re-deriving numbering, so the CLI, panel, and pager agree. Keep render_sparkline for the panel row unless the scrubber is adopted deliberately.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1ef explicitly scoped itself to the pager surfaces (plan §10 Non-goals: 'sase memory history text output and the Memory panel History row keep their current look'); changing CLI output and the ACE panel is a separate surface change with its own goldens.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by phase bead sase-1ef.5 as the plan's §10 follow-up: the pager now names versions with a four-state pill and 'now ≡ vN', but the CLI text output and Memory panel History row still use the older vocabulary, so surfaces disagree.
